description: The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy, comparing initial accuracy, final accuracy, and the change in accuracy. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence", has a linear scale, ranging from 0.91 to 0.99, with a regular interval of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with a regular interval of 0.2. There are three lines in the plot: the blue solid line representing "Final Accuracy" starts at approximately 0.92 at an initial confidence of 0.91, remains relatively steady with a slight peak of 1.0 at 0.93, dips to 0.83 at 0.965, and ends at around 0.88 at 0.995; the orange dashed line representing "Δ Accuracy" begins at 0.57 at 0.91, peaks at 0.65 at 0.92, and then declines to 0.15 at 0.985; the green dash-dotted line representing "Initial Accuracy" starts at 0.28 at 0.91, dips to 0.26 at 0.92, rises to 0.87 at 0.985, and ends at 0.78 at 0.995, with both the orange and green lines showing error bars indicating variability.
